title: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
claims: Sections on chemical analysis and pairwise sensory correlations discuss shared fermentation patterns and unexpected associations of ethyl octanoate/decanoate with hop perception and bitterness.
The model-dissection section describes ethyl acetate as fruity/solvent/alcoholic and lactic acid as contributing tart taste.
support_boundary: 本题附件主要源自同一研究，不能作为本样本关联的独立外部重复验证；研究中的加标结果也不验证全部135个Top-3位置。

title: Ridge Regression: Biased Estimation for Nonorthogonal Problems
Influence of Ethyl Acetate, Isoamyl Acetate and Linalool on off-flavour Perception in Beer
claims: The paper describes cabbage-like DMS and buttery diacetyl and tests their perception in lager beer.
Ester and linalool additions changed DMS/diacetyl thresholds; effects depended on compound and concentration.
support_boundary: 该来源支持缺陷感知和基质交互；没有检验本题DMS感官Top-3的松油烯-4-醇、E-橙花叔醇等候选，不能据其认定相关候选可消除缺陷。DOI未在所核实出版者页面给出。

title: Key constituents, flavour profiles and specific sensory evaluation of wheat style non-alcoholic beers depending on their production method
journal: Journal of the Institute of Brewing
claims: Table 2 reports GC-O/MS odor qualities including banana for isoamyl acetate, clove for 4-vinylguaiacol, floral/citrus for linalool, and fruity/glue for ethyl octanoate.
The same table identifies acidic acetic acid and several fruity esters; the study emphasizes matrix/process dependence.
support_boundary: 嗅闻口气味与特定啤酒样本提供定性依据；不等于这些物质对本题45个评分的因果系数或原量尺校准。未据气味表验证辛酸乙酯产生苦味。

title: The Contribution of Geraniol Metabolism to the Citrus Flavour of Beer: Synergy of Geraniol and β-Citronellol Under Coexistence with Excess Linalool
journal: Journal of the Institute of Brewing
claims: Beer sensory experiments found combined geraniol and β-citronellol made excess linalool more fruity/citrus; coexistence of the three compounds supported synergy.
support_boundary: 支持特定试验基质中的单萜醇协同，不提供每一种萜烯对任意感官项的直接机制，也不能将试验浓度直接作为通用阈值。

title: Characterization of Key Odor-Active Compounds in Draft Beers for the Chinese Market Using Molecular Sensory Science Approaches
claims: Draft-beer GC-O/AEDA identified odor-active 1-hexanol; section 2.3 described a hawthorn note, not a banana-specific effect.
The sensory panel used acetaldehyde as a raw-green reference; this was a training reference rather than an acetaldehyde-to-malty dose-response experiment.
support_boundary: 四款鲜啤及其重组研究仅补充气味背景；不支持把正己醇等同香蕉酯香，或把乙醛视为麦芽、焦糖味的直接来源。文中阈值不替换附件阈值。

title: The brewing value of Amarillo hops (Humulus lupulus L.) grown in northwestern USA: A preliminary study of terroir significance
journal: Journal of the Institute of Brewing
verified_locator: Brewing trials; sensory analyses; discussion of hop-oil profiles in beer
claims: Single-hop brewing trials compared Amarillo hops from Idaho and Washington using otherwise identical recipes.
Different citrus/floral profiles occurred with changes in limonene, linalool, methyl geranate and other compounds.
support_boundary: 提供啤酒中柑橘相关萜类的背景和混合物证据；多成分同时改变，不能分离柠檬烯的单独作用，更不能解释本题丁香味的正相关。

title: Study on Characteristic Aroma in Special Beers Brewed with Coriander (Coriandrum sativum L.) Seeds: Profiling of Flavor Compounds Derived from Coriander Seeds in Different Growing Areas
claims: Camphor, carvone and (E)-anethole were detected in Bulgarian coriander seeds and the beers made with them.

support_boundary: 本次核验出版者摘要；支持樟脑的原料来源与特定混合物花香协同，不证明樟脑单独产生橙味或丁香味。

title: Release of Deuterated Nonenal during Beer Aging from Labeled Precursors Synthesized in the Boiling Kettle

title: Time–intensity characteristics of iron compounds
verified_locator: Publisher abstract, stimuli and results excerpts
claims: Human time-intensity tests of ferrous sulfate, chloride and gluconate solutions found persistent metallic sensations.

support_boundary: 实验对象为较高浓度二价铁盐溶液，不是啤酒总铁；只列一般背景，不据此给本题总铁设金属味阈值，亦不支持总铁导致甜味。
